gloss: another world; paradise; a place apart

definitions.gloss: another world; a place apart; paradise
definitions.explanation: A place so different from ordinary surroundings that it feels like a separate world. Almost always positive: quiet, beautiful, or refreshingly free of everyday pressures.

examples.japanese: ⟦ここ→ここ：00961_koko⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦まるで→まるで：03739_marude⟧{別天地|べってんち}だ。
examples.english: This place is like another world.

examples.japanese: ⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{静|しず}か→静か：00755_shizuka⟧で、{別天地|べってんち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ようだった。
examples.english: The mountaintop was quiet, like a world apart.

examples.japanese: ⟦{都会|とかい}→都会：02475_tokai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{騒音|そうおん}→騒音：03315_souon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{離|はな}れる→離れる：02397_hanareru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{島|しま}→島：00885_shima⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦まさに→まさに：00270_masani⟧{別天地|べってんち}⟦である→である：09855_dearu⟧。
examples.english: Away from the noise of the city, this island is truly a world of its own.

examples.japanese: ⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{研究所|けんきゅうじょ}→研究所：19075_kenkyuujo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧まったく⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧{別天地|べってんち}らしい。
examples.english: Even within the same company, the research lab is apparently a world apart in atmosphere.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧ (separate) + {天地|てんち} (heaven and earth, the world). Most often used with ⟦まるで→まるで：03739_marude⟧ or ⟦まさに→まさに：00270_masani⟧ to compare a real place to an ideal one.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦まるで→まるで：03739_marude⟧{別天地|べってんち}だ: it is just like another world
- {別天地|べってんち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ような⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧: a place like a world apart
- ⟦ここ→ここ：00961_koko⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{別天地|べってんち}だ: this is a place apart

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {桃源郷|とうげんきょう}: Shangri-La — a legendary utopia, more literary and idealized
- {楽園|らくえん}: paradise — emphasizes pleasure and abundance rather than separation from the ordinary
- ⟦{別世界|べっせかい}→別世界：30357_bessekai⟧: another world — near-synonym, but can also describe social worlds one does not belong to
